radio.notes: PHY capability and electrical measurement conditions are distinct. Do not reuse the BLE TX samples as verified 802.15.4 current data. Radio supply-current accounting with an active application CPU still needs characterization. Where a 3 V measurement supply is specified, power_w is derived as V × I; the original current and its measurement scope are retained. This does not establish constant power across supply voltages.
